item.description:
Why this matters: Hospitality system impact — check guest-facing services and PMS/POS status.

item.title: 🔵 When "idle" isn't idle: how a Linux kernel optimization became a QUIC bug
item.description:
Why this matters: Leadership context — useful for risk, budget, and vendor conversations.
We investigated a bug where CUBIC's congestion window became pinned at its minimum floor, causing a performance to plummet. The fix involved correctly measuring idle periods to distinguish RTT wait times from actual application idleness.
